messages.subject: CMC order and trial window - Pennington v Tregarth
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Henry,

The CMC took place today before HHJ Marwood. The sealed order is attached. Key dates: disclosure lists by 25 July; witness statements by 19 September; expert reports exchanged by 31 October with a joint statement by 28 November; 4-day trial in a window from 9 February 2026.

Henry - we'll need to finalise your witness statement over the summer. I'll send a draft shortly.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
